about_the_game:
A crumbling apartment building. A mountain of debt. A tangle of sultry strangers with too many secrets and not enough shame. But The Burrows is yours now, welcome to the mess.

Tenant Tails is an episodic erotic visual novel where you play a struggling writer who inherits a half-broken apartment complex full of misfits, perverts, and dangerously lonely souls. To survive, you'll need to manage the property, balance the books, and navigate the heated tension behind every thin wall.

Six episodes. Six tenants. Six deeply personal fuck-drenched journeys through anthro romance, adult drama, and explicit furry erotica.

It all starts with Maya the prim, no-nonsense fox girl who’s been running The Burrows in your absence.
She doesn’t think you’re ready. She doesn’t think you’re serious.
But she can’t stop looking at you like her next meal. 

🛠️ Gameplay Features

  • 🔞 Episodic Erotic Narrative – Six character-focused episodes delivered through DLC to the base game. Each episode introduces a new tenant to seduce, understand, and fuck. 

  • ✒️ Writer in Over His Head – You’re not just fixing pipes—you’re digging into stories, uncovering pasts, and stirring up hornets' nests of raw emotion and rawer sex.

  • 🐾 Fully-Illustrated Anthro Smut – Each scene lovingly rendered, fully explicit, and dripping with detail. You see it. You hear it. You make it happen.

🌶️ Installment Schedule

Tenant Tails is delivered in six hot, heavy doses:

  • Episode 1: Maya (Superintendent, fox, secretly starving for touch) – Available at launch

  • Episode 2: ??? – Coming Soon

  • Episode 3: ???

  • Episode 4: ???

  • Episode 5: ???

  • Episode 6: ??? – Finale

Each episode expands the narrative and The Burrows itself—new rooms, new mechanics, new ways to fuck up (or fuck better). Each episode will come as a low cost DLC.
